verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence documents no bulk export of all account data, no open-format export, and no exit path such as card or token data migration. The reconciliation and settlement reports are a bookkeeping feature, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
